items.statement: Unless exempt, register each domestic establishment that manufactures, repacks, relabels, or salvages a drug or an animal feed bearing or containing a new animal drug, and each foreign establishment doing so whose drug or animal feed is imported or offered for import into the United States.
items.quote: Unless exempt under section 510(g) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act or this part, all manufacturers, repackers, relabelers, and salvagers must register each domestic establishment that manufactures, repacks, relabels, or salvages a drug, or an animal feed bearing or containing a new animal drug, and each foreign establishment that manufactures, repacks, relabels, or salvages a drug, or an animal feed bearing or containing a new animal drug, that is imported or offered for import into the United States.

items.statement: Where operations are conducted at more than one establishment under common ownership and control, the parent, subsidiary, or affiliate company may submit registration information for all establishments.
items.quote: When operations are conducted at more than one establishment and common ownership and control among all the establishments exists, the parent, subsidiary, or affiliate company may submit registration information for all establishments.
items.condition: multiple establishments under common ownership and control

items.statement: Register each domestic establishment no later than 5 calendar days after it begins to manufacture, repack, relabel, or salvage a drug or an animal feed bearing or containing a new animal drug.
items.quote: Registrants must register each domestic establishment no later than 5 calendar days after beginning to manufacture, repack, relabel, or salvage a drug or an animal feed bearing or containing a new animal drug at such establishment.

items.statement: Register each foreign establishment before any drug or animal feed bearing or containing a new animal drug manufactured, repacked, relabeled, or salvaged there is imported or offered for import into the United States.
items.quote: Registrants must register each foreign establishment before a drug or an animal feed bearing or containing a new animal drug manufactured, repacked, relabeled, or salvaged at the establishment is imported or offered for import into the United States.

not_applicable.text: § 207.21 When must initial registration information be provided?

items.statement: Include in establishment registration: the name of the owner or operator of each establishment; for a partnership, each partner's name; for a corporation, the name of each corporate officer and director and the place of incorporation.
items.quote: Name of the owner or operator of each establishment; if a partnership, the name of each partner; if a corporation, the name of each corporate officer and director, and the place of incorporation;

items.statement: Include in establishment registration: each establishment's name, physical address, and telephone number(s).
items.quote: Each establishment's name, physical address, and telephone number(s);

items.statement: Include in establishment registration: all names of the establishment, including names it does business under or is known by.
items.quote: All name(s) of the establishment, including names under which the establishment conducts business or names by which the establishment is known;

items.statement: Include in establishment registration: the registration number of each establishment, if FDA previously assigned one.
items.quote: Registration number of each establishment, if previously assigned by FDA;

items.statement: Include in establishment registration: a Unique Facility Identifier per the system specified under section 510 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act.
items.quote: A Unique Facility Identifier in accordance with the system specified under section 510 of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act.

items.statement: Include in establishment registration: all types of operations performed at each establishment.
items.quote: All types of operations performed at each establishment;

items.statement: Include in establishment registration: the name, mailing address, telephone number, and email address of the establishment's official contact.
items.quote: Name, mailing address, telephone number, and email address of the official contact for the establishment, as provided in § 207.69(a); and

items.statement: Include in establishment registration: for a foreign establishment, the name, mailing address, telephone number, and email address of the United States agent.
items.quote: The United States agent, as provided in § 207.69(b);

items.statement: Include in establishment registration: for a foreign establishment, the name, mailing address, telephone number, and email address of each United States importer, known to the establishment, of drugs manufactured, repacked, relabeled, or salvaged there.
items.quote: Each importer in the United States of drugs manufactured, repacked, relabeled, or salvaged at the establishment that is known to the establishment; and

items.statement: Include in establishment registration: for a foreign establishment, the name, mailing address, telephone number, and email address of each person who imports or offers for import such drug to the United States.
items.quote: Each person who imports or offers for import such drug to the United States.

not_applicable.text: § 207.25 What information is required for registration?

items.statement: Update registration information no later than 30 calendar days after closing or selling an establishment.
items.quote: Closing or selling an establishment;

items.statement: Update registration information no later than 30 calendar days after changing an establishment's name or physical address.
items.quote: Changing an establishment's name or physical address; or

items.statement: Update registration information no later than 30 calendar days after changing the name, mailing address, telephone number, or email address of the official contact or the United States agent.
items.quote: Changing the name, mailing address, telephone number, or email address of the official contact or the United States agent.
items.condition: official contact or US agent details change

items.statement: The registrant, official contact, or United States agent may notify FDA of changed information for the designated official contact or United States agent, but only the registrant may designate a new official contact or United States agent.
items.quote: A registrant, official contact, or United States agent may notify FDA about a change of information for the designated official contact or United States agent, but only a registrant is permitted to designate a new official contact or United States agent.

items.statement: Review and update, for each establishment, all required registration information: owner/operator, partner, officer and director names and place of incorporation; establishment names, physical address and telephone numbers; registration number if assigned; Unique Facility Identifier; types of operations; official contact details; and, for foreign establishments, contact details of the United States agent, known importers and persons offering for import.
items.quote: Registrants must review and update all registration information required under § 207.25 for each establishment.

items.statement: If initial registration occurs before October 1, perform the first review and update of registration information between October 1 and December 31 of the year of initial registration.
items.quote: The first review and update must occur during the period beginning on October 1 and ending December 31 of the year of initial registration, if the initial registration occurs prior to October 1.

items.statement: Perform subsequent reviews and updates of registration information annually between October 1 and December 31 of each calendar year.
items.quote: Subsequent reviews and updates must occur annually, during the period beginning on October 1 and ending December 31 of each calendar year.

items.statement: Make the annual registration update reflect all changes since the last annual review and update.
items.quote: The updates must reflect all changes that have occurred since the last annual review and update.

items.statement: If nothing has changed since the last registration, certify at the annual review that no changes have occurred.
items.quote: If no changes have occurred since the last registration, registrants must certify that no changes have occurred.

not_applicable.text: § 207.29 What are the requirements for reviewing and updating registration information?
Expedited updates.
Annual review and update of registration information.

items.statement: Give each finished drug product or unfinished drug subject to drug listing a unique NDC identifying its labeler, product, and package size and type.
items.quote: Each finished drug product or unfinished drug subject to the listing requirements of this part must have a unique NDC to identify its labeler, product, and package size and type.

items.statement: Format each NDC as 10 or 11 digits in three segments (labeler code, product code, package code), except for an alternatively formatted NDC approved for certain minimally manipulated HCT/Ps.
items.quote: Except as described in paragraph (b)(4) of this section, the NDC must consist of 10 or 11 digits, divided into three segments as follows:

items.statement: Make the first NDC segment the labeler code of 4, 5, or 6 digits, within an NDC of 10 or 11 digits (except approved alternative HCT/P formats).
items.quote: The first segment of the NDC is the labeler code and consists of 4, 5, or 6 digits.

items.statement: Make the second NDC segment the product code of 3 or 4 digits, in one of the permitted labeler-product-package length combinations (except approved alternative HCT/P formats).
items.quote: The second segment of the NDC is the product code and consists of 3 or 4 digits, as specified in paragraphs (b)(2) and (3) of this section.

items.statement: Make the third NDC segment the package code of 1 or 2 digits, in one of the permitted labeler-product-package length combinations (except approved alternative HCT/P formats).
items.quote: The third segment of the NDC is the package code and consists of 1 or 2 digits as specified in paragraphs (b)(2) and (3) of this section.

items.statement: With a 5- or 6-digit labeler code, a 4-digit product code and 1-digit package code may be used, for a total NDC of 10 or 11 digits (5-4-1 or 6-4-1).
items.quote: A product code consisting of 4 digits and a package code consisting of 1 digit for a total NDC length of 10 or 11 digits (5-4-1 or 6-4-1), or

items.statement: With a 5- or 6-digit labeler code, a 3-digit product code and 2-digit package code may be used, for a total NDC of 10 or 11 digits (5-3-2 or 6-3-2).
items.quote: A product code consisting of 3 digits and a package code consisting of 2 digits for a total NDC length of 10 or 11 digits (5-3-2 or 6-3-2).

items.statement: With a 4-digit labeler code, use only a 4-digit product code and 2-digit package code, for a total NDC of 10 digits (4-4-2).
items.quote: If a labeler code is 4 digits in length, it may be combined only with a product code consisting of 4 digits and a package code consisting of 2 digits for a total NDC length of 10 digits (4-4-2).

items.statement: A registrant or private label distributor uses only one product-package code configuration for a given labeler code (e.g. 3-digit product with 2-digit package code, or 4-digit product with 1-digit package code).
items.quote: A registrant or private label distributor with a given labeler code must use only one Product-Package Code configuration (e.g., a 3-digit product code combined with a 2-digit package code or a 4-digit product code combined with a 1-digit package code).

items.statement: Use that single product-package configuration in every NDC containing the labeler code that is voluntarily reserved or submitted with drug listing information.
items.quote: This single configuration must be used in all NDCs that include the given labeler code that are reserved in accordance with § 207.33(d)(3) or listed in accordance with § 207.49 or § 207.53.

items.statement: An alternatively formatted NDC approved by the relevant Center Director may be used for minimally manipulated HCT/Ps: hematopoietic stem/progenitor cells derived from peripheral and cord blood, and lymphocytes collected from peripheral blood.
items.quote: An alternatively formatted NDC that is approved for use by the relevant Center Director may be used for the following HCT/Ps if they are minimally manipulated: Hematopoietic stem/progenitor cells derived from peripheral and cord blood, and lymphocytes collected from peripheral blood.
items.condition: minimally manipulated listed HCT/Ps; approved format

items.statement: Each person manufacturing, repacking, relabeling, or private label distributing a drug subject to listing applies for an NDC labeler code.
items.quote: Each person who engages in manufacturing, repacking, relabeling, or private label distribution of a drug subject to listing under this part must apply for an NDC labeler code, by providing the following information:

items.statement: In the NDC labeler code application, provide the name, physical address, email address, and other contact information FDA may request of the person for whom the code is requested.
items.quote: The name, physical address, email address, and other contact information FDA may request, of the person for whom the NDC labeler code is requested;

items.statement: In the NDC labeler code application, provide the types of activities (e.g. manufacture or repacking) the requester engages in with respect to human drugs.
items.quote: The type(s) of activities (e.g., manufacture or repacking) in which the person requesting the NDC labeler code engages with respect to human drugs; and

items.statement: In the NDC labeler code application, provide the types of drugs (human, animal, or both; prescription, nonprescription, or both) the code will be applied to.
items.quote: The type(s) of drug(s) (human, animal, or both, and prescription, nonprescription, or both) to which the NDC labeler code will be applied.

items.statement: A holder of an NDC labeler code updates the information submitted in its labeler code application within 30 calendar days after any change to it.
items.quote: Each person who is assigned an NDC labeler code must update the information submitted under paragraph (c)(1)of this section within 30 calendar days after any change to that information.

items.statement: Each manufacturer, repacker, or relabeler proposes to FDA for assignment an NDC including its own labeler code for each package size and type of drug it manufactures, repacks, or relabels for commercial distribution.
items.quote: Each manufacturer, repacker, or relabeler must propose for assignment by FDA an NDC that includes its own labeler code for each package size and type of drug that it manufactures, repacks, or relabels for commercial distribution.

items.statement: If a drug is distributed under a private label distributor's trade name or label, the manufacturer, repacker, or relabeler also proposes for FDA assignment an NDC including that private label distributor's labeler code for each package size and type so distributed.
items.quote: In addition, if a drug is distributed under the trade name or label of a private label distributor, the manufacturer, repacker, or relabeler must also propose for assignment by FDA an NDC that includes the labeler code of the private label distributor under whose trade name or label the drug is distributed, for each package size and type so distributed.

items.statement: A manufacturer, repacker, relabeler, or private label distributor may voluntarily reserve a proposed NDC for a drug before it is listed by submitting the required reservation information.
items.quote: A manufacturer, repacker, relabeler, or private label distributor may voluntarily reserve a proposed NDC for a drug, before the drug is listed, by submitting the following information:

items.statement: When voluntarily reserving an NDC before listing, submit a proposed NDC that meets the NDC requirements.
items.quote: A proposed NDC that conforms to the requirements of this section;

items.statement: When voluntarily reserving an NDC before listing, submit the established name of each active ingredient and the strength of each active ingredient in the drug.
items.quote: The established name of the active ingredient(s) and the strength of each active ingredient in the drug; and

items.statement: When voluntarily reserving an NDC before listing a finished drug product, submit its dosage form and route of administration.
items.quote: In the case of a finished drug product, the dosage form, and route of administration.
items.condition: voluntary NDC reservation; finished drug product

items.statement: Submit NDC labeler code applications and updates, and NDC proposal and reservation information, electronically unless FDA grants a waiver.
items.quote: The information described in paragraphs (c) and (d) of this section must be submitted electronically unless FDA grants a waiver under § 207.65.
